subject: Agenda Format Changes and Harassment Policy Revisions
overview: The subcommittee recommended several structural changes to the School Committee agenda format and advanced updated policies on staff conduct and harassment. A proposed revision to the Title IX grievance procedure was tabled to allow for legal consultation regarding federal compliance.

items.title: Agenda Format Revisions
items.summary: Recommended moving routine items to a consent agenda at the end of meetings, shifting the secretary's report to the community participation section, and adding student representatives to the attendance roll call.

items.title: Staff Conduct Policy
items.summary: Recommended the staff conduct policy for approval by the full committee.

items.title: Harassment Policy
items.summary: Recommended an amended harassment policy to the full committee for a first reading.

items.title: Title IX Grievance Procedure
items.summary: Tabled the review of the updated Title IX grievance procedure to permit further legal review and administrative consultation.
